# v1.20.1 — HACS maintainer and release downloads

HACS now identifies **PlainSeer** as the maintainer of this fork, instead of
linking its author badge to the upstream maintainer. Senalse's original-author
credit and the MIT copyright notice are retained.

Releases now include **alphaess_modbus.zip**, which HACS downloads directly.
The package contains the complete integration, frontend modules, translations,
brand images and licence, with the layout HACS expects. Releases become public
only after the package has uploaded successfully.

GitHub and HACS documentation include a release-download badge. These counts
include updates, repeat downloads and manual downloads; they are not a count
of unique installations. Earlier source-archive downloads cannot be recovered.
The star and open-item counts continue to reflect this fork's GitHub metadata.

The Main, Readings and Diagnostics dashboard, existing entities, controls and
Modbus behaviour are unchanged from v1.20.0. The existing dashboard previews
remain current.

Update to **v1.20.1** through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh its frontend.
HACS refreshes repository metadata from GitHub; an already-open page may need
to be reopened after updating. No dashboard reconfiguration is required.

Validation includes both supported Home Assistant test environments, frontend
tests, HACS/hassfest validation and a package test that checks every integration
file and extracts the ZIP into the same target layout HACS uses.
